title: What newshell_llm is
summary: An ooRexx shell made for an LLM or an agent (Codex) to use, with a person (or a bounded autopilot) approving. The LLM is given shell objects, writes ooRexx proposals that use them, and registers multi-step plans that run on their own and report back. Every protected call is authorised by the ooRexx security manager against a text policy. Console: bin/nsh.rex (verbs start llm, mount fs/ws, provide, prompt, proposal, ~run, jobs, inbox, wait, autopilot, policy, decisions).
authority: built and tested (architecture Tom Dyer; coding and writing Claude (Opus 5.5), 2026-11-24)
invariants: Every protected method call from LLM or console code goes to the security manager
Plans report back; the LLM never polls
procedure: Read newshell.proposal, newshell.security and newshell.jobs before writing objects for it
Read newshell.next for the ED209 plan
